about: The course format's step kinds and fields (docs/plus-courses-build-plan.md 6a; web/course/format/README.md). Each kind says which app plays it: yes, no (that app says 'open this lesson on the web'), or unknown (not verified). web/tool/course_check.py fails on a kind or field not listed here. Add a field here when you add it to a lesson, with a line saying what it is.

learn.about: A headline, up to three cards, a picture; may play an example (listen: an exercise)

try.about: Wait for me: each note plays and waits until it's found; unscored

play.about: Hear it, then sing it back (turn: true), or sing over a drone or chords (turn: false); scored

use.about: Opens a song in Sing; done after 20 seconds sung

record.about: Records a part in Sing; scored on pitch

wave.about: The trace lane: ride a ribbon (a steered wave, a straight line, a bloom, a free hold, a contour); `keep` saves the first take on the device under a key, and `thenAndNow` shows it beside today's

choose.about: Listen and choose, no mic: tap a clip or a word; `base: flip` lays its clips from the singer's flip note (Yodeling)

selfcheck.about: What we can't hear yet: hear a model, record, compare, answer self-check questions; never scored; its model may name a real singer's clip (`clip`), with `seconds` and a `description` until it's recorded; `base: flip` lays its model from the singer's flip note (Yodeling)

bullseye.about: Echo a note and see where it landed (Perfect your pitch: docs/courses/perfect-pitch.md)

breathhold.about: A held note that ends when you stop (Breath and stamina: docs/courses/breath.md)

play.about: A play, try or learn-listen exercise's fields. Those marked web-only make the step web-only for now.

fields.turn: true: hear it, then sing it back; false: sing over the drone or chords
fields.drone: { step, fadeAfter?, fadeOver? }: a held note under it; with fadeAfter it fades to silence from that many beats after the exercise's start (the listen phase included) over fadeOver beats (4 by default)
fields.chords: [{ beat, root, quality, bass }]: chords under it, root in semitones from home
fields.score: how it's starred: hold, or a registered scorer (web/js/lesson-scores.js)
fields.show: vibrato: describe a held note's vibrato after the take
fields.base: flip: steps laid from the singer's flip note (Yodeling)
fields.under: { step }: sing over that earlier step's take, this visit
fields.with: partner lines that sound while you sing (Counterpoint: docs/courses/counterpoint.md 8b)
fields.answer: the notes to sing back when they differ from the call (call and response)
fields.guide: false: no guide notes (a cold start)
fields.droneAfter: with guide: false, the drone comes in this many beats into your turn
fields.window: a lazy scoop's time to arrive, in seconds (Pop and country: docs/courses/pop-country.md)
fields.giveNote: true: a Give me my note button while you sing your turn (not through a speaker); the note is played quietly, once, and never scored (Folk: docs/courses/folk.md)
fields.rules: with score species: contrary (three moves against the first partner), all (every first-species rule), close (four moves in five a step or less, with some real moving) or against (half the moving notes against the tune) for three stars (docs/courses/counterpoint.md 8b)
fields.lights: how your notes are drawn, all still scored: on (the default), fade (the second half faint), changes (only where the chord changes), late (after a beat off) or off (Improvising a harmony: docs/courses/improvising-harmony.md)

fields.step: semitones from the learner's comfortable note (do = 0)
fields.vibrato: { hz, cents, after, jitter }: the guide's own vibrato on this note
fields.bend: [[seconds, cents], ...]: the guide's pitch path on this note
fields.style: scoop, fall, slide or cry (Pop and country: docs/courses/pop-country.md)
fields.ring: false: never ring-scored (a chord with no pure tuning, such as a diminished seventh)
fields.cents: a pure-tuning offset for this note (Barbershop)

segment.about: A wave step's target: one segment after another

fields.kind: wave, straight, bloom, free or path
fields.cents: a wave's width, plus or minus
fields.fade: seconds for the ribbon to fade (the ghost wave)
fields.straight: a bloom's straight seconds before the wave
fields.band: a path's ribbon width, plus or minus cents
fields.voice: head: the guide sings this segment in head voice
